authority.backlog: GitHub Issue #3 and linked research issues

currentFocus.title: Direct short-horizon outcome surfaces and fast-excursion propensity
currentFocus.subfocus: Real same-origin history coverage measurement captured and analyzed: 1,639,803 rows with exact index coverage; cadence p50=5096ms, p95=6541ms, p99=8895ms; 5s is low-coverage (37.1971% non-edge), 10s is 99.3017%, and 20–120s are 100% non-edge strict endpoint-evaluable. Global endpointTolerance is now fixed at 7229ms from the worst p99 endpoint timing error across 10–120s. Path-gap and minimum-path-coverage policy remain unresolved.

completedWorkUnits.title: Consolidate chat research into durable repository artifacts
completedWorkUnits.result: Workstream shell, routing and durable checkpoint capture the research developed through Family Scores plus ASK/LAST spread-position dynamics and recent wave-memory/capacity additions.

completedWorkUnits.title: Objective alignment audit and first-principles short-horizon hypotheses
completedWorkUnits.result: Re-audited existing research against the capturable seconds-to-~2-minute objective, reframed conventional context/signals, introduced direct outcome/latency hypotheses, and propagated requirements into the downstream research backlog.

completedWorkUnits.title: Build feature registry and evidence taxonomy
completedWorkUnits.result: Registered and deeply documented 176 material feature/state entries across PW/AF/BD/TE/FQ/PH/PR/SQ/RO/WM/MR/CS, completed ownership/double-counting audits, and mapped all remaining checkpoint concepts to explicit downstream research issues.

completedWorkUnits.title: Core predictive signal prioritization and feature reduction
completedWorkUnits.result: Reduced eight provisional concepts to four universal interfaces plus one conditional Renewal reserve, separated predictor/protective/synthesis roles, and fixed a leakage-safe incremental empirical selection contract with smallest-model preference.

completedWorkUnits.title: Precursor-to-price conversion latency and opportunity half-life
completedWorkUnits.result: Collapsed six timing candidates into two nested timing interfaces: ConversionTimingState under Progress Conversion Efficiency and OpportunityEvidenceDecayProfile/UsableLeadBudget under Remaining Opportunity Lifecycle; book-pressure timing remains diagnostic/validate-only and no universal half-life is assumed.

completedWorkUnits.title: Simplify Momentum Ranking into practical Hebrew metric shortlist
completedWorkUnits.result: Converted the broad research into a comprehensive plain-Hebrew practical guide with live-activity/data-validity gates, four universal decision interfaces (Fresh BID Repricing, Activity→Price Progress, Path Usability, Remaining Opportunity), one conditional Fresh Reset/Renewal interface, explicit intuitive-metric verdicts, window semantics, formulas, failure modes, examples and a no-double-counting/no-arbitrary-threshold contract. Spread remains ignored for ranking/eligibility and raw diagnostic only.
